options.source:
fly:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Fly{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: ELYTRA
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow kingdom flight in"
        - "your land."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Fly{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: ELYTRA
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow kingdom flight in"
        - "your land."
    posx: 1
    posy: 1
  build:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Build{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: DIAMOND_PICKAXE
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow building in your land."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Build{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: DIAMOND_PICKAXE
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow building in your land."
    posx: 2
    posy: 1
  ceasefire:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Ceasefire{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: DIAMOND_SWORD
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Disable friendly fire."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Ceasefire{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: DIAMOND_SWORD
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Disable friendly fire."
    posx: 3
    posy: 1
  interact:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Interact{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: CAULDRON
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow block interaction for opening containers."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Interact{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: CAULDRON
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow block interaction for opening containers."
    posx: 4
    posy: 1
  use:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Use{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: LEVER
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow using blocks."
        - "Such as doors, levels and buttons."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Use{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: LEVER
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow using blocks."
        - "Such as doors, levels and buttons."
    posx: 5
    posy: 1
  turret-ceasefire:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Turret Ceasefire{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: SPECTRAL_ARROW
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Disable friendly fire for turrets."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Turret Ceasefire{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: SPECTRAL_ARROW
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Disable friendly fire for turrets."
    posx: 6
    posy: 1
  manage-turrets:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Manage Turrets{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: ARROW
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow breaking, placing and"
        - "interacting with turrets."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Manage Turrets{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: ARROW
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow breaking, placing and"
        - "interacting with turrets."
    posx: 7
    posy: 1
  manage-structures:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}Manage Structures{$colon} {$p}Enabled"
      material: REDSTONE_LAMP
      flags: [ HIDE_ENCHANTS ]
      enchants:
        DURABILITY: 1
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow breaking, placing and interacting with structures."
    else:
      name: "{$p}Manage Structures{$colon} &cDisabled"
      material: REDSTONE_LAMP
      lore:
        - "{$sep}Allow breaking, placing and interacting with structures."
    posx: 8
    posy: 1

  back:
    name: "{$p}Back"
    material: PLAYER_HEAD
    skull: "{$gui-back}"
    lore:
      - "{$s}Go back to nexus menu."
    posx: 9
    posy: 1

    else:

    posx: 1
